grader: exact-label, hedge-aware family (validated 98.9% vs human labels 2026-08-04)
interpretation: The moat claim requires the TRAINED model to gain MORE from the signed corpus than an untrained size-matched control does. If both gain equally, the corpus is doing generic in-context learning and the trained operator is not special.

FINDING.headline: MOAT CLAIM NOT SUPPORTED. Grounding lift is NEGATIVE for both models, and MORE negative for the trained one.

lifts.reading: Supplying the signed provision inventory made BOTH models worse. The trained operator lost more than the untrained control.

FINDING.contradicts: A pilot reported +19pt grounding lift at n=8 with a keyword grader and no control. At n=90 with a validated grader and a control arm, the lift is -7.8pt for the trained model.

CONFOUND_I_MUST_FLAG.what: sov34 produced 35 unparseable answers closed-book and 21 grounded, against the control's ZERO.
CONFOUND_I_MUST_FLAG.why_it_matters: The four cells therefore have different denominators (55, 69, 90, 90). sov34 is scored on a SUBSET of items it happened to answer in the required format, and that subset differs between its own two conditions. Its closed-book vs grounded comparison is not strictly like-for-like.
CONFOUND_I_MUST_FLAG.direction_unknown: Whether the unanswered items were harder or easier than the answered ones is not measured.
CONFOUND_I_MUST_FLAG.what_would_fix_it: Restrict all cells to the intersection of items every cell answered parseably, then re-compare.

what_this_DOES_show: Supplying a provision INVENTORY does not improve EU AI Act classification for either model.
The untrained control matches the trained operator closed-book (0.511 vs 0.527, overlapping) — consistent with the day's other findings.
sov34 has a severe instruction-following deficit: 39% unparseable closed-book vs the control's 0%.
what_this_does_NOT_show: That the signed corpus is worthless. The context here is the provision INVENTORY with excerpt anchors, NOT the statutory text — the snapshot is article-level. This tests whether knowing WHICH provisions exist helps. It does not test whether READING them helps.
That grounding cannot work. A paragraph-level snapshot supplying actual provision text is the untested and more plausible version of the thesis.
FINDING.honest_status: Neither lift is individually resolved — all four intervals overlap. The claim is NOT SUPPORTED, not REFUTED.
